what_this_is: Patient-level bootstrap intervals around test-partition point estimates that were already frozen and already reported. No model, threshold, representation or condition was chosen here.
what_this_is_not: Not a new test-set evaluation and not a model comparison. No p-value is reported. The one interval that excludes zero (the paired model-minus-leak-bar delta) is a post-hoc observation and must be labelled as such.

bootstrap.why_patient_level: Images from one patient share a diagnosis. An image-level bootstrap treats correlated rows as independent and understates the interval, which is the direction that manufactures significance.

leak_bar_note: The leak-bar score is -roi_area_fraction. roi_geometry_leak rank-transforms it to [0,1] first; ROC-AUC and average precision are rank statistics and invariant under that monotone map, which the anchor check verifies to 1e-12.

conditions.description: Condition A: every row of the oracle cache, whichever annotation supplied the ROI. Confounded by annotation practice -- see the subdivisions.

roc_auc_minus_leak_bar.interpretation: Positive means the classifier ranked these rows better than ROI area alone on the same resampled patients. An interval containing zero means the condition's headline discrimination is not separable from its crop geometry at this sample size. POST-HOC: descriptive, not a pre-registered test.
